lastCompletedStory.title: Add durable plan-escalation marker module and event kind

openQuestions: The ship-stalled marker precedent (.cam-ship-stalled.json, src/release/merge-watch.ts) has NO .gitignore entry in either .gitignore or templates/.gitignore despite being durable runtime state written directly by the sidecar. This story added its own marker's entry in both files but did NOT retroactively fix the pre-existing gap for .cam-ship-stalled.json (out of scope: not touched by this story's diff). A future story should add `.claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json` to both gitignore files.
nextStoryContext: US-002 added src/supervisor/plan-escalation.ts: PLAN_ESCALATED_FILENAME = '.cam-plan-escalated.json' (relative to .claude/ dir) plus readPlanEscalatedMarker/writePlanEscalatedMarker/removePlanEscalatedMarker, structurally cloned from the ShipStalledMarker precedent in src/release/merge-watch.ts (JSON reader shape guard on every required field: issueId:string, summary:string, findings:array, roundsCompleted:number, writtenAt:string; never throws; write/remove are best-effort). Also added 'plan-escalated' to WorkerEventKind and PlanEscalatedEventDetail ({ issueId, roundsCompleted }) to the WorkerEventDetail union in src/supervisor/events.ts. Neither the marker module nor the event kind is wired into plan-runner.ts yet -- US-003 (BLOCK->re-plan loop with capped rounds + teardown seam) must: (a) consume MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS and buildReplanPlannerTaskPrompt from US-001 to drive the actual re-plan spawn loop, (b) call writePlanEscalatedMarker + emit the 'plan-escalated' event when the loop exhausts MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS without an APPROVE verdict (ADR-0012: non-convergence is a hard stop, never proceed-with-debt), and (c) implement the teardown seam so the worker pane is properly torn down on escalation. US-004 (wire the loop into the sidecar) and US-005 (orchestrator derives escalation on wake) will consume readPlanEscalatedMarker + removePlanEscalatedMarker respectively -- mirror the .cam-ship-stalled.json boot-surface pattern in subagent-orchestrator.md (read the marker at boot, surface as an opening blocker, never delete it yourself; only the loop removes it on a later clean plan for the same issueId). file-size-budget.json ceiling for src/supervisor/events.ts was raised 488->507 with a CAM-204 tracker ref; expect further raises across US-003/US-004/US-005 as the loop wiring lands.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-002 only touches node:fs (existsSync/readFileSync/writeFileSync/unlinkSync, Bun's Node-compat built-in) and intra-repo type imports; no external npm library surface was exercised.
